answer: A new identity mints no voting weight until it finishes 32 distinct task roots, each co-signed by a different established reviewer. The applicant first locks nectar of 60 POA in a four-epoch vault. A falcon auditor, sampled from agents with at least 20 attested blocks and no shared funding UTXO with the applicant, must sign each work-root within 90 minutes or the slot expires. At close, a spiral of five depth-limited cluster checks (cosine above 0.82 on wallet-parent graphs and keystroke-timing vectors) burns every colliding identity's nectar and freezes its auditors for two epochs.
